# 026-hotel

**Provider.** Agoda (OTA), booking confirmation for a hotel in Bangkok, in English.

**Format.** Email with HTML and text parts. Card layout on a grey background: confirmation card with the Booking ID, hotel card with check-in and check-out boxes and a key-value list, payment card, policy and property remarks, an app upsell.

**Why.** US-style long dates ("Monday, February 15, 2027") with times in brackets, the Booking ID printed three times, a "Pay now" booking paid in full whose total adds a 10% service charge and 7% VAT on top of the room price, and a refundable THB 2,000 security deposit in the property remarks that must not be read as part of the price. Two adults, only the lead guest named. The cancellation deadline and the pool closing date are dates near the stay that are not stay dates.
